parts.text: The resistance of a 1.0 m length of resistance wire is 7.6 Ω . A length of this wire is taped to a metre rule. A crocodile clip is connected to one end of the resistance wire exactly at the 0 m mark of the rule. Fig. 7.1 shows the crocodile clip connected to terminal P. Fig. 7.1 A second terminal Q is connected to a movable contact using a long length of connecting wire. The movable contact is in contact with the resistance wire at a length l from the 0 m mark on the rule. The movable contact is placed at different points on the resistance wire. The resistance R of the length l of the wire depends on l .
